name: Jordan Ranch Market
summary: Jordan Ranch Market is a grocery-anchored community center in affluent Fulshear, Texas, featuring H.E.B. as its anchor tenant in 40,190 square feet. Located just off I-10 with easy access to the Energy Corridor, the center serves one of Greater Houston's most prosperous communities with household incomes averaging over $206,000.
demographics: Jordan Ranch Market serves an affluent suburban community in Fulshear/Katy, Texas, with a trade area population of over 63,000 within three miles. The primary market consists of upper-income families with an average household income of $206,441 and home values averaging $559,646, representing one of the most prosperous demographics in the Greater Houston area. The center attracts young to middle-aged professionals and families who prioritize convenience and quality, with shopping patterns focused on weekly grocery trips to H.E.B. and regular visits for services and dining. The daytime population of nearly 50,000 indicates strong employment in the surrounding Energy Corridor, creating additional weekday traffic from working professionals seeking lunch options and after-work shopping.
description: Jordan Ranch Market is a thriving community shopping center strategically located on Jordan Crossing Boulevard in the rapidly growing Fulshear area of Greater Houston. Positioned just one mile south of Interstate 10, the center offers exceptional accessibility to both the prestigious Energy Corridor employment hub and the Grand Parkway, making it a convenient destination for one of Texas's most affluent communities. Anchored by H.E.B., one of Texas's most beloved grocery chains, this 40,190 square foot center serves a prosperous trade area where average household incomes exceed $206,000 and home values average over $559,000. Developed and managed by Regency Centers, a nationally recognized leader in grocery-anchored shopping center development, Jordan Ranch Market exemplifies the company's Fresh Look® philosophy of creating vibrant neighborhood gathering places. The center's tenant mix is carefully curated to serve the daily needs of surrounding families while maintaining the quality and convenience expected by this discerning market.
